sections.title: Research
sections.content: Research & Innovation Cell 250  + Research Publications 310 + Innovative Projects 25+ Patents Published 22+ Active MoU's 20225+ carpet Area The TKR Centre for Research and Innovation at the TKR College of Engineering and Technology intends to persuade students to be pragmatic by helping them to transform basic scientific, technological, and abstract ideas into practical reality. The TKR Centre for Research & Innovation with a 21000sft carpet area will provide an ecosystem for the students to learn by doing and will support them in thinking critically, being innovative, visualizing products, and developing and implementing prototypes. The Lab will serve as a cross-disciplinary and multiple stakeholders’ platform to enable student entrepreneurship, collaboration with the industry, and commercialization. R & D Dean Dr. B. Rajini Kanth Professor and Dean of R&D, has been working at TKR College of Engineering and Technology since Jan 2012. He has been awarded Junior Research Fellowship when he was in doctoral studies and finished his Ph.D. in Physics from Osmania University in 2005. He has been appointed as Research Associate as well as Visiting Associate for S.N. Bose National Center for Basic Sciences during 2007-20012 and 2013-2016 respectively. He rejoined this college in the year 2012 as an Associate Professor, during that period, he acted as the Coordinator for the Digital Classes also. Acted as a Principal Investigator DST project entitled “Determination of Magnetic field induced Strain in CoNiAl FSMAs for Sensors and Actuators”, during 2013-2016 worth Rs. 17.04L. In the year 2016, he presented a paper orally at Kyto JAPAN for which he got full funding(1.5 L) from UGC, New Delhi. Recently one of his paper was accepted for presentation at an International Conference to be held in the USA(TEXAS A&M University) during May 2023. He has 32 Journal publications, 26 paper presentations(oral) at symposia, was invited for lectures in the colleges and universities in different seminars and workshops, presented 20 poster presentations, organized few conferences, and attended national and international conferences. He is guiding a few research scholars for their Ph.D work. Also acted as a reviewer for the Journal of Materials today. Recently  JNTUH accorded PhD guide ship for guiding students for their PhD.He is recently promoted to Dean Research and Development. ACHIEVEMENTS OF R&D; CELL R & D cell of TKRCET has achieved prestigious recognition in terms of Patents, Research Publications & Research Grants etc., MSME 51 + Received Projects 17+ Uploaded Projects 2 Sanctioned Projects
